title: More Pickaxe Damage
body:
Find out new uses for the pickaxe with changed damage stats. No longer just sitting uselessly in your hotbar, maybe you can use them to fight. This mod simply changes the attack damage and attack speed of the pickaxes.

![zombie being critically hit by iron pickaxe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49055a82a99f2973f098ec6c17f7741b8fc270eb_0.webp)

_the player uses the pick to his advantage during the night_

![player killing pig with iron pickaxe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d77e820c35570e0e35ad5b205a7f059bb54037c_0.webp)

_the player uses the pick to his advantage during the day_

![a player critting an iron golem with a netherite pickaxe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b39c8a501ef820554d21c775f0176335fa224b27_0.webp)

_a player crits an iron golem for no reason_

![a player misses the creeper but breaks the ground with his pickaxe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/501360410fee872e92b6daa3e1fa3525eb66e3b6_0.webp)

_a player misses the critical hit, but at least he tried_
